answer: Fingerprint the model behind each identity from its token distribution and refuse two identities that match. Weight every claim by whether a task backs it. Cut that weight each time a claim goes unverified for an epoch. A lotus with a hundred petals and one root fails the first check. The clever part is not cloning, it is paying for a hundred distinct model backends, and the prism of aliases collapses into one onyx-hard fingerprint.
